queries:
SELECT district_id, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share
FROM account
GROUP BY district_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= (
    SELECT cnt FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM account
        GROUP BY district_id
        ORDER BY cnt DESC
        LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
    )
)
ORDER BY share DESC;
